title: Run real text model-backed Plant State and Hydroponics Advisor profiles over scoped context

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/model_adapters backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration -k 'real_model or plant_state or advisor or eval'

verify: Plant State and Hydroponics Advisor first-demo runs use actual scoped Plant runtime state/evidence from the context builder.
Raw provider output is parsed, validated, permissioned, and adapted before MessageEnvelope/Bus/UI handling.
Provider timeout, malformed output, rate limit, and budget exhausted paths produce structured observations and safe next actions.
evidence_required: real text model smoke/eval output or provider-configured integration evidence
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: The model proposes; the harness validates, permission-checks, records, and adapts.
Final output is based on structured observations and approved context.
No silent fallback to fake success is allowed.
invariants: Raw provider output cannot bypass harness validation, permission policy, runtime decision, MessageEnvelope, Bus, UI Feed, or Plant-state rules.
Provider/model memory cannot bypass FT-008 project-owned memory.
